SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   C. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

10. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.

12. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. B — Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. B — Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. A — Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A — Plan income and spending wisely

9. C — Nairobi

10. C — Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Historic Built Environments in the County; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Interdependence of people; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Population Distribution; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
